title: FONY tips
intro: FONY is a free internet radio and Web3 music player with an AI console, local files, skins and a liquid-glass theme. Pick a topic, or grab a random tip.

tips.title: Pick a genre
tips.text: Open the [[ui:genre|genre menu]] and choose a style: each one is a live 24/7 station list. Type in the [[ui:search|search box]] to filter the genre, or to search across every genre at once.

tips.title: Random and shuffle
tips.text: The [[ui:random|dice button]] jumps to a random genre and station. [[ui:shuffle|Shuffle]] plays stations of the current list in random order; next and previous skip.

tips.title: Favorites
tips.text: Tap the heart on a station to keep it. Open the [[ui:favorites|favorites list]] and sort it by your own drag order, date added, genre or A–Z. Drag rows to reorder.

tips.title: Add your own playlist
tips.text: Press [[ui:addPlaylist|+]] next to the genre menu and paste any M3U link, or browse the community catalog. Custom playlists are saved in your browser and sit next to the built-in genres.

tips.title: Share a station
tips.text: Use the share icon on the playing row to copy a link straight to that station. Opening a link like fony.fun/techno starts that genre right away.

tips.title: Dead streams fix themselves
tips.text: If a stream goes silent, FONY detects it and skips to the next station; stations that keep failing get hidden.

categories.title: Local files
categories.summary: Play music from your own computer.

tips.title: Turn it on
tips.text: Click the [[ui:local|folder icon]] in the top bar to enter Local mode; it turns into a radio icon, click that to go back to radio. Needs desktop Chrome, Edge, Opera or Brave.

tips.title: Add folders
tips.text: Add folders with the picker or drag them onto the list. FONY remembers them; after a browser restart it asks you to re-allow access.

tips.title: Browse and play
tips.text: Navigate folders with the breadcrumbs. Play one track, a whole folder (subfolders included) or a playlist, and click the active track to seek.

tips.title: Playlists
tips.text: Create, rename and reorder your own playlists, and add any track or folder with the + button. Everything stays in your browser.

tips.title: Your files stay yours
tips.text: Files are never copied or uploaded. Only the text “Artist - Title” is sent to look up cover art, and the cover embedded in the file is used if Discogs has none.

categories.title: Console & commands
categories.summary: Ask the AI, look things up, tune the sound.

tips.title: /similar and /facts
tips.text: [[cmd:/similar|/similar]] suggests tracks like the one playing; [[cmd:/facts|/facts]] tells you something about the artist or the track.

tips.title: /discogs
tips.text: [[cmd:/discogs|/discogs]] shows release details from Discogs for the current track: year, label, country, genre and cover, with quick YouTube, Spotify and Tidal links.

tips.title: /mood
tips.text: Describe a vibe with [[cmd:/mood|/mood]], like “90s rock” or “something chill”, and FONY finds a live station that fits right now.

tips.title: /collection
tips.text: Save the playing track to your personal collection with [[cmd:/collection|/collection]] and get AI recommendations built from it.

tips.title: /equalizer
tips.text: [[cmd:/equalizer|/equalizer]] applies a genre-tuned EQ preset to the sound, or toggles the Analog FX mode for a warm old-radio feel.

tips.title: Resize or hide the console
tips.text: Drag the top edge of the console to make it taller. The player controls shrink to make room and, when it gets tight, switch to a single row. The “–” in its corner [[ui:console|folds it away]]; the >_ button brings it back.

tips.title: Console on your phone
tips.text: Tap the >_ button in the corner of the screen to open the console as a panel, and tap outside it to close.

tips.title: Three themes
tips.text: The [[ui:theme|button in the top bar]] cycles dark, light and liquid glass, and its icon shows the theme a click switches to. Liquid glass bends the light like real glass; it looks best in Chrome, Edge and Opera, other browsers get a softer version.

tips.title: Skins
tips.text: [[cmd:/skins|/skins]] generates a fresh procedural background. Save the one you like, reset to the default, drop in a GIF, or use the current album art. Skins work on top of any theme, and in liquid glass they become the scene behind the glass.

tips.title: Album art
tips.text: The cover found on Discogs shows up behind the play button; with a cover the button shrinks so the art stays visible. Use it as your skin from /skins.

tips.title: Visualizers
tips.text: Click the [[ui:visualizer|animated bars]] above the controls to switch between five styles: bars, line, fish, lava and sheep.

tips.title: Resize the panels
tips.text: Drag the divider between the player and the list to change their width; double-click it to go back to the default.

tips.title: Connect a wallet
tips.text: [[ui:wallet|Connect a MetaMask-compatible wallet]] to play audio from a hand-picked set of NFT collections on Ethereum and Soneum.

tips.title: Seek in NFT tracks
tips.text: NFT tracks have a fixed length, so unlike radio you can scrub through them. The Random button in this mode picks a collection and a track.

tips.title: Open settings
tips.text: Use the [[ui:settings|gear in the top bar]]. You can hide stations that stream over plain http and switch to a left-handed layout that mirrors the screen.

tips.title: Backup and restore
tips.text: Everything FONY remembers (favorites, playlists, skins, collection) lives in your browser. Back it up to a file, restore it on another device, or reset the app from the same dialog.

tips.title: Donate
tips.text: FONY is free. If you enjoy it, [[cmd:/donate|/donate]] shows the crypto addresses to support its development.
